correctness.rationale: Rows 0,1,2,3 give a Vandermonde determinant whose modulus is 64 sin(πa/N)sin(πb/N)sin(πc/N)sin(πd/N)sin(π(a+b)/N)sin(π(b+c)/N) for positive cyclic gaps totaling N. The strictly concave even-about-N/2 function f(t)=log sin(πt/N) gives opposite-gap balancing |a−c|,|b−d|≤1; transferring one unit between opposite pair sums when they differ by ≥3 improves L strictly. Enumerating the remaining balanced integer cases proves gaps (q,q,q,q), three q and one q+1, alternating q and q+1, or one q and three q+1, for N mod4=0,1,2,3. For N≡2 adjacent large gaps have smaller diagonal sine product cos(π/N)<1 than alternating; Hadamard covers divisible-by-four case. Orbit-stabilizer gives N/gcd(N,4) literal optimizers. Independently enumerated all 118755 four-subsets for N=4..28, checking independent six-chord product, maximal values and all predicted sets. Finite census is corroboration only; concavity and case analysis establish all N≥4.
residual_risks: The result is for fixed four consecutive rows and the unnormalized determinant; no claim of general condition-number optimality.
